description: This file defines React components and hooks for displaying and managing error messages within a trace viewer UI, including error rendering, code frame generation, and error context fetching.

classes.name: CopyPromptButton
classes.description: React component for a button that copies a prompt string to clipboard.

methods.name: useErrorsTabModel
methods.description: Custom React hook that creates a model of errors from a MultiTraceModel.

methods.name: ErrorView
methods.description: React component that displays an individual error message with location and action.

methods.name: ErrorsTab
methods.description: Main React component that displays a list of errors, fetches error context, and builds code frames.

methods.name: codeFrame
methods.description: Function that generates a code frame string highlighting the error location in source code.
